title: wire::array silently truncates lengths >65535 producing corrupt CBOR
description: rust/lichen-client/src/checkin.rs:239-249 and deaddrop.rs:438-448: final branch emits 0x99 with len as u16 - silently truncated for len>65535 instead of erroring (text writers truncate above u32::MAX, unreachable). Latent only today but violates deterministic-writer contract and reachable via >64k-entry RollcallStatus re-encode. wire::map has a debug_assert; array has none. Fix: add u32 branch + debug_assert! or return Error::Encode for lengths beyond supported range; unit test the error path.
